source.label: NITA GeoAI mobile field records
caveats: The dashboard reads the authenticated NITA GeoAI field-survey API and falls back to same-origin browser storage only when the API is unavailable. Empty sources are shown as an explicit no-records state.
GPS accuracy is device-reported and depends on hardware and field conditions.

metricDefinitions.label: Field record
metricDefinitions.definition: One saved road or stormwater asset survey record with a mandatory GPS fix and Photo 1.
